sents.t: My refrigerator is empty, so today I go to the supermarket.
It is big, very big!
In my country, our stores are small.
I take a shopping cart and walk in.
First, I go to the fruit and vegetable section.
I put bananas, apples, carrots, and potatoes in my cart.
Everything is fresh.
Next, I need chicken and rice.
The meat is at the back of the store.
Then I look for coffee, but I can’t find it.
“Excuse me,” I say to a worker.
“Where is the coffee?”
“Aisle seven, next to the tea,” he says.
At the checkout, the cashier smiles.
“Hi! Paper or plastic?”
I don’t understand.
“Sorry?”
“Your bags. Paper bags or plastic bags?”
“Oh! Paper, please.”
Everything is forty-two dollars.
That is a lot of money, but now I have food for the whole week.
I carry the heavy bags home.
Max waits at the door.
He smells the chicken!

comp.q: Why does Sam go to the supermarket?
What does Sam put in his cart first?
comp.fa: سام اول چه چیزهایی در چرخ خریدش می‌گذارد؟

o: at the back of the store

comp.fa: مکس بوی چه چیزی را حس می‌کند؟
